correctness.rationale: The exact domain is all pairwise-intersecting families of 3-subsets of seven points. The published rational Betti theorem gives degrees 6,9 with ranks 29,7; the 2024 theorem gives seven independent embedded crosspolytope top cycles. The S6 stabilizer orientation sign is checked explicitly. For all 15 S7 classes, invariant simplices correspond bijectively to independent subsets of a finite orbit incompatibility graph, yielding reduced Lefschetz trace -I(Q;-1). The standalone verifier computes every graph and table value with exact integer recurrence, independently brute-checks all 12 quotient graphs of at most 15 vertices, checks a transposition orientation and complete S7 character-table orthogonality, and recovers both displayed Specht decompositions. No finite observation is extended beyond seven points.

value.rationale: The case of seven ground points is the first Kneser-triple independence complex with nonzero degree-six rational homology. Its rank 29 is a highlighted structural mystery in the contemporary literature. Splitting 29 as a unique trivial line and two nonisomorphic sign-twisted fourteen-dimensional irreducibles gives the complete natural permutation-symmetry structure and explains the uniform odd-permutation trace. It supplies concrete constraints for any future explicit basis and is not a renaming, a marginal numerical improvement or a mere restatement of known ranks.
